messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up to the admission RFC — we need an operational playbook for fair-share during abuse spikes. Proposal: an "emergency soft-cap" layer that triggers per-tenant and per-route; non-essential routes degrade first. Thoughts?
hiro: Like the idea. Main tradeoff is signal quality vs noisy kicks. How exactly do we detect an "abuse spike"?
sam: Suggest combine three signals: >3x baseline QPS, 95th latency jump, and abuse-score >= 0.7. All three reduces false positives.
maria: Agreed. Telemetry must clearly show which tenants were softened and why.
elaine: Detector sketch: moving-window QPS ratio, small EWMA on latency, normalized abuse-score from detector service. Pseudocode: 
```
if qps_ratio > 3 and ewma_latency > baseline*1.5 and abuse_score >= 0.7:
  trigger_soft_cap(tenant, route, reason="qps+latency+abuse")
```
hiro: What does soft-cap do in practice? Throttle tokens? Switch model? Block routes?
sam: Layered enforcement: 1) reduce non-critical route concurrency by 30%, 2) force cheaper model variant if available, 3) apply token budget per request. Full block only as last resort.
maria: Add TTL (60s) and decaying backoff to avoid oscillation. Also include manual override.
elaine: Ops asks: manual escape hatch, retrospective logging and alerts if same tenant hits soft-cap 5x in 10m.
hiro: Interface boundary: should detector live in admission-service or edge? I prefer admission-service for consistency across Hosted/Dedicated/Private.
sam: Admission-service decides; edge enforces quick rejects. Flow: detector -> admission-service (policy decision) -> edge (enforcement).
maria: Telemetry: add trace tag `soft_cap.reason`, emit event to ops-alerts stream, and create dashboard panels for per-tenant timelines.
elaine: Enforcement config sketch: 
```json
{"soft_cap": {"concurrency_reduction_pct": "30", "variant_fallback": "gpt-lite", "token_budget": "1000", "ttl_seconds": "60", "escalate_if_reapplied": "5"}}
```
sam: Consider stepped reduction (30 -> 50 -> 80) if signals persist.
hiro: Stepping adds ephemeral state. Keep state in admission keyed by tenant+route with a backoff counter.
maria: Ops playbook bullets: 1) Threshold mapping to customer-impact levels, 2) How to read dashboard, 3) Runbook to manually apply/lift soft-cap, 4) Post-mortem template for customer-impact events.
elaine: Action items: hiro proto detector flags (due EOD Tue), sam draft enforcement API and PR, maria mock dashboards and alert rules, ops draft runbook section.
hiro: I'll add a small loadtest to validate tail latency reduction when enforcement runs.
sam: Enforcement API proposal: `POST /v1/softcap/apply {tenant,route,config}` and `GET /v1/softcap/status?tenant=`. Keep it minimal.
maria: Tag events so we can replay in telemetry infra: add `trace_id` and `replayable=true`.
elaine: Rollout plan: blue/green admission-service change with a 1% canary for 24h before broad rollout.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: admission-service/detector-proto -> canary (sha:abc123). :rocket:
elaine: Thanks. Will keep thread updated with PR links and dashboard mock screenshots.
